fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.
stability_check: Raw Internet Archive id_ replay of a fixed capture, fetched with plain curl (no Accept-Encoding, no decoding). First downloaded on 2026-09-30T23:41:40Z; downloaded again at 2026-10-01T00:31:38Z, at least 30 minutes after the first, with the same byte count and SHA-256 (140775 bytes). The base32 SHA-1 of the bytes equals the Internet Archive's CDX digest for the capture.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of the DA's original page, captured at 2020-11-01T14:02:57Z (before the 7 September 2026 cutoff); that form replays the archived bytes unchanged and is used in place of any live copy (the archived capture fixes the bytes of a page the live site may still change). The response identity recorded here was confirmed by downloads at least 30 minutes apart (see stability_check). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
